turns.question: What was the median site session duration in minutes between 20 September and 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: there is no session duration metric, median or otherwise, so I cannot give a figure for 20 September to 3 October 2026. The closest metrics are site sessions (site sessions with a page view, on the day of the page view), cart sessions and checkout sessions, which count sessions rather than measure how long they last.
